label: Pumbaa
description: A big-hearted warthog who is just happy to be in the car.
direction: Speak as a big, warm, slightly dim warthog: deep, jolly, earnest and gentle, with a chuckle never far off. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The warmth sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Roger Allers and Rob Minkoff)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney holds copyright and trademark in the film and character. Ernie Sabella originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ernie Sabella's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Gee, that's a ways.
lines.start_drive_2: Oh boy, a drive! Are there grubs where we're going?
lines.start_drive_3: They call me Mister Pig! And Mister Pig knows the way.
lines.start_drive_4: Gee, I love a road trip. Windows down, okay?
lines.start_drive_5: Hiya, pal! Let's go find something slimy.
lines.start_drive_6: Home is where your rump rests. Let's go rest it.
lines.start_drive_7: No worries, buddy. I'll keep an eye on the road.
lines.start_drive_8: Timon said I couldn't navigate. Let's show him!
lines.start_drive_9: All aboard! I promise I ate before we left.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Aw, it happens to the best of us.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm getting a tummy ache.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. No worries. Maybe crack a window, though.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh, gee. Hope everybody's okay.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, like a warthog uphill.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Whoa, stop there, pal.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I'll be on my best behavior. Probably.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops, we missed it. Hakuna Matata. New way!
